companies.name: サムスン電子
companies.sub: スマホ特許ライセンス

relations.text: 売上の10%以上を占める主要な特許ライセンス先である
relations.text_en: Samsung is one of three licensees each providing 10% or more of revenue

source.label: InterDigital 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: In fiscal 2025, revenue (in descending order) from Samsung, Apple, and vivo each comprised 10% or more of our consolidated revenue.

companies.name: アップル
companies.sub: スマホ特許ライセンス

relations.text: 2022年にアップルとの特許ライセンス契約を更新した
relations.text_en: InterDigital renewed its patent license agreement with Apple in 2022

source.label: InterDigital 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: In 2022, we renewed a multi-year, royalty-bearing, worldwide, and non-exclusive patent license agreement with Apple (the “Apple PLA”).

companies.name: エイチピー
companies.sub: パソコン特許ライセンス

relations.text: 2025年4月にHPと複数年のライセンス契約を結んだ
relations.text_en: InterDigital signed a multi-year license agreement with HP in April 2025

source.label: InterDigital 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: In April 2025, we signed a new multi-year license agreement with HP Inc.

companies.name: レノボ
companies.sub: パソコン特許ライセンス

relations.text: 2024年にレノボと新ライセンス条件を決める仲裁に合意した
relations.text_en: InterDigital agreed with Lenovo in 2024 to arbitrate a new patent license

source.label: InterDigital 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: Additionally, in 2024 we entered into an arbitration agreement with Lenovo to determine the terms of a new patent license for our cellular and other technologies.

companies.name: シャオミ
companies.sub: スマホ特許ライセンス

relations.text: 2026年1月にシャオミとのライセンスを更新した
relations.text_en: InterDigital renewed its license with Xiaomi in January 2026

source.label: InterDigital 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: In January 2026, we renewed a worldwide, non-exclusive, royalty bearing license with Xiaomi.

companies.name: LGエレクトロニクス
companies.sub: テレビ特許ライセンス

relations.text: 2026年1月にLGエレクトロニクスと新たな特許ライセンスを結んだ
relations.text_en: InterDigital signed a new patent license agreement with LG Electronics in January 2026

source.label: InterDigital 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: In January 2026, we signed a new patent license agreement with LG Electronics.

relations.text: ソニーとテレビ・モニター向けの特許を合わせて共同でライセンスしている
relations.text_en: InterDigital and Sony combine DTV and CDM patent portfolios for joint licensing

source.label: InterDigital 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: Under the Madison Arrangement, InterDigital and Sony combine portions of their respective DTV and CDM patent portfolios and have created a combined licensing opportunity for DTV and CDM manufacturers.

relations.text: 機器向けの特許ライセンス先の一社である

source.label: InterDigital 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: Additionally, we entered into device licenses covering our technologies with a significant social media company, along with Eaton, Seiko Solutions Inc., Sharp, and Teltronic.

relations.text: 機器向けの特許ライセンス先の一社になっている
relations.text_en: Eaton is among the companies with device licenses

source.quote: Additionally, we entered into device licenses covering our technologies with a significant social media company, along with Eaton, Seiko Solutions Inc., Sharp, and Teltronic.
